title: Road tour hardships and car accidents
summary: He tells of a winter tour from St. Louis through Ohio and West Virginia, with car wrecks and freezing weather, ending with him quitting in 1935.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters
